summary: Alan Webb (account 60215) contacted HomeNet due to repeated service failures – three outages this month, two missed technician visits, and a wrong bill. The agent logged all issues under one reference and assigned them to a case manager for resolution within two business days. They addressed the incorrect billing by correcting it today and applied an interim credit as compensation for the inconvenience caused.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent acknowledged the customer’s name promptly and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent used “Alan Webb” as the greeting, demonstrating personalization.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent responded to the client's frustration with "I understand your frustration," validating their feelings.

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a calm tone throughout the conversation, avoiding interruptions and using polite language ("Please tell me everything"). [RoBERTa flagged 2 harsh agent line(s)]

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated the customer’s issue (“That’s a lot to deal with…”) to confirm understanding.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated Alan Webb's account details ("Thank you, Alan.").

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: The agent asked probing questions about the specific issues (outages, missed visits, bill).

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: – The agent clearly stated the next steps and timeline for resolution.

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent offered a solution to correct the billing error and apply an interim credit.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: The agent took responsibility for resolving the issue.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: The agent listened attentively to Alan’s complaints without interruption.

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution
ratings.reason: The agent confirmed that the billing error was corrected and the case manager would be handling it.
